text:
Ravi S: Rolling out release key-rotation/2026.03.15 to prod now (canary=10%). Patch changes REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY_ID and sets MODEL_ROTATION=true. Kicking off at 2026-03-15T18:02:03Z.

Hannah G: getting paged, seeing generation requests 502/5xx from the ml-proxy layer. Pulling logs.

oncall-bot: Pager triggered -> PD-90011 (severity: high) for service: model-key-service "KMS Decrypt AccessDenied". Escalation policy: infra-oncall.

Hannah G: sample error snippet from ml-key-proxy: 
```
WARN 18:02:15 KmsDecryptFailed - AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/deploy-agent is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:111122223333:key/a1b2c3d4-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-abcdef123456
```

incident-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-03-15-3267. Lead: Hannah G. Status: investigating.

Ravi S: halting rollout. Flipping feature flag model-rotation to off.

Infra-CI: featureflag-service API: PATCH /flags/model-rotation {"enabled":false} -> 200 OK. Canary reduced to 0%.

KeyMgmt-Bot: New key created by pipeline user deploy-agent at 2026-03-15T18:01:58Z (create-event: ev-77d). Key policy: admin-only; did not include runtime role.

Ops-SRE: root cause looks like key policy omission. The pipeline created a restrictive key and the deploy inserted REDWOOD_MODEL_KEY_ID pointing at it; runtime role doesn't have kms:Decrypt.

incident-bot: Action log: rollback requested; kill-switch applied; investigating permissions.

Hannah G: immediate mitigation: 1) stop rollout (done), 2) revert env var to prior key ID (doing now), 3) ask security to patch key policy or re-encrypt material with approved policy.

Infra-CI: env var rollback applied at 18:03:42Z. Canary stopped. Traffic rolled back to baseline routing.

Support Lead: customer impact: support volume spiked, ~42 tickets in 5 minutes reporting 5xx on text-generation endpoints. Preliminary estimate: 2.8% failed requests during window 18:02:12Z-18:03:45Z. Dedicated-customers disproportionately hit. No alerts of data exfiltration.

Ravi S: assigning remediation: Security/Ops to adjust key policy OR reprovision key with templated policy. Also add pre-deploy verification to CI: ensure iam principals listed in key policy.

Security-Ops: opening CR-KEYPOL-2026-0315 to add arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/infra-runtime to key policy with kms:Decrypt permission. CR submitted.

Hannah G: testing decrypt with assumed infra-runtime role after policy change. Please update when CR applied.

KeyMgmt-Bot: policy edit applied at 18:12:08Z. Propagation confirmed in AWS.

Hannah G: manual decrypt test passed at 18:12:45Z. Starting a limited canary referencing the new key while keeping MODEL_ROTATION=false. Monitoring closely.

Ops-SRE: metrics: error spike peaked at 6.1% for generation requests in us-east-2, global spike ~2.9%. Total failed requests in window ~1.4k. Baseline restored by 18:13:30Z.

incident-bot: Incident status -> monitoring. Lead: Hannah G. Postmortem owner: Ravi S. Handoff scheduled at 18:30Z.

Support Lead: customer comms: sending templated message to affected accounts: "We experienced transient 5xx for a subset of requests during a key rotation rollout. Issue mitigated quickly; no data exposure suspected. We're following up with a postmortem and fixes."

Ravi S: temporary mitigations captured: - revert rotation in pipeline immediately - require key policy templating in pipeline - add preflight step in CI to simulate decrypt using infra-runtime credentials - update runbook with explicit feature-flag kill-switch commands and pagerduty contacts.

PM - Jules: please quantify SLA impact for exec summary: percent of requests impacted and duration.

Hannah G: SLA numbers: impact window ~1m 33s (18:02:12Z-18:03:45Z). Peak error window was ~60s. Customers affected: ~8 flagged accounts for priority notifications.

Security-Ops: we'll audit who has rights to create KMS keys from pipeline accounts and require templated policies that include infra roles by default. Opening follow-up ticket SEC-AUDIT-3267.

incident-bot: Post-incident tasks logged: TASK-1 (pipeline preflight) owner: Ravi S; TASK-2 (policy templates) owner: Security-Ops; TASK-3 (runbook update) owner: Ops-SRE. Due in 7 days.

Hannah G: switching to monitoring. Thanks for fast rollback. Will run full postmortem doc and timeline.

(oncall-bot automated): Reminder - postmortem checklist and customer impact form due in 48 hours.
